'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Hey there, how's life treating ya? You know, sometimes you have to come in and shoot the shit out of someone in CQC, and you have to do it quietly and efficiently. I prefer 12 gauge for example, and I got no clue why the hell BEARs and USECs don't appreciate it, it's a straight caliber, you know? You just gotta get as close as possible, and if you have silencer, man, you can drop people and the guy on other side of the wall wouldn't flinch. It hits silently and it hits hard. You gotta master this, while I figure out what fish we could pull out with your "talent".}}

==Requirements==
* Must be level 30 to start this quest.

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 20 [[Scavs]] while using a suppressed [[12/70#Weapons_that_use_it|12 gauge shotgun]]
* Eliminate 10 PMCs while using a suppressed [[12/70#Weapons_that_use_it|12 gauge shotgun]]

==Rewards==
* +18,000 [[EXP]]
* [[Skier]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.05'''</font>
* 100,000 Roubles
** 105,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 115,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[MP-155 12ga semi-automatic shotgun]] (variant Ultima)
{{quote|You did good, now you got my respect! I'll keep you in mind if I have something interesting.}}

==Guide==
This quest can be done with any [[Weapons#Shotguns|shotgun]] that uses [[12/70|12/70 ammunition]].

'''Bug:''' The [[Saiga-12K 12ga automatic shotgun (Redline)]] does currently not work for this quest.
